mods.name: Meica Mod
mods.description:
Mod about the Vtuber Meica05 that includes Brotecitos in the world, new ores, new biome, weapons, and much more.

Among the main features:

- Meica Forest Biome: Explore a new and dangerous exclusive biome. This biome features large trees, tameable brotecitos, anda dense green fog that has detrimental effects on you as you spend more time in it, offering a new and exciting environment for your adventures.

- Mineral Brotenite: Discover "Brotenite", a new and rare mineral more valuable than Netherite and only found inside theBrotenite Geodes, located within the Meica Forest.

- Brotenite Armor: Equip yourself with the Brotenite armor, which protects you from the damaging effects of the Meica Forest, allowing youto venture into the forest and collect resources more safely.

Why download Meica Mod?
The Meica Mod is ideal for Meica05 fans and those seeking a Minecraft experience enriched with content inspired by their favorite Vtuber.With new mechanics, a themed biome, and custom elements, this mod offers a fun way to bring your passion for Meica into the world of Minecraft.

Compatibility:
Client and Server: The Meica Mod requires installation on both client and server to ensure that all features, including the Meica Forest biome andBrotenite Armor, are available in both environments.

Discover how the Meica Mod can elevante your Minecraft experience and immerse yourself in a world filled with the magic of Meica05!
